Lightning strikes kill people and livestock across multiple Indian states

Multiple incidents of lightning strikes have been reported across India, resulting in fatalities among people and livestock. In Madhya Pradesh, four individuals died and eight were injured. Other states also reported deaths, including three in Odisha and one in Telangana. Additionally, 21 cows were killed by lightning in Telangana's Mulugu district. These events highlight the dangers posed by severe weather phenomena.
